physics_check.note: Energy balance: ΔT ≈ Δα × S / h (S=750 W/m², h=25 W/m²K) × roof share. In this city, albedo and built-up density are correlated (r=0.47 here) — darker roofs coincide with denser building, so the model already explains most warming through built-up features and has little signal left for albedo alone. The physics formula is the more trustworthy number for a single roof; the model's plan-level total reflects this conservatism.
